renderer.group: try flat using pinned Prettier string-width semantics: ANSI controls and combining U+0300-U+036F width 0, East Asian fullwidth and emoji width 2, other scalars width 1; tabs advance to next tabWidth stop; first hardline forces break; suffixes flush in source order before newline
renderer.newline: configured LF/CRLF/CR, auto uses first source line ending; literal/raw/recovery bytes never normalized
renderer.final_newline: one configured final newline for nonempty formatted syntax; empty stays empty; retained islands unchanged
renderer.order: source order, independent of registration and scheduling

edits.algorithm: Use ordered retained provenance units as stable anchors. In each changed gap, strip the maximal equal Unicode-scalar prefix, then nonoverlapping maximal equal scalar suffix. Emit the remaining replacement only. Adjacent gaps coalesce only when no retained authored unit or byte separates them. Insertions at an equal boundary follow rendered source order. No global quadratic diff or whole-file fallback.

maps.retained: exact byte correspondence at scalar boundaries
maps.inserted: no authored preimage; return typed inserted with left/right boundary anchor
maps.deleted: no formatted interior; left affinity chooses preceding retained endpoint, right chooses following endpoint
maps.replaced: interior is typed ambiguous unless proven by retained provenance; never interpolate
maps.shared_boundary: left picks preceding segment, right following segment
maps.crlf: never split CRLF for edits/range expansion; query inside pair is typed invalid boundary
maps.eof: source EOF maps to formatted EOF with right affinity; left uses preceding endpoint
maps.bom: retained BOM has exact source-backed identity

range.algorithm: Expand to the smallest complete source-backed statement/declaration, markup element, style rule or carrier block containing the selection. Empty range selects its containing safe unit; EOF selects the preceding complete unit. Repeatedly include required delimiter/trivia ownership, without splitting tokens, holes, literal/raw/recovery islands or CRLF. Refuse unowned regions and non-unique codec preimages. Only unit-owned leading indentation and trailing newline may expand boundary whitespace; outside bytes remain unchanged.

cursor.affinity: explicit left/right; default right; retained exact, inserted/deleted anchored, replaced ambiguous

stability.idempotence: F(F(source)) = F(source), second pass has zero edits
stability.schedule: registration/discovery/scheduling permutation yields identical bytes, ordered edits and maps
stability.incremental: same final exact basis yields same cold/incremental bytes, ordered edits and maps
